decisive_spans.text: The mother reported finding the child peeling off skin with marked facility.
Complete separation of the stratum corneum

response.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including skin fragility, peeling skin, and complete separation of the stratum corneum, strongly support Peeling skin syndrome. While Psoriasis is also supported by a clean split just above the stratum granulosum, the peeling skin and complete separation of the stratum corneum are more specific to Peeling skin syndrome.
